hero_lead: HACCP, FRESHCARE, HARPS and SEDEX certification, and UN Global Marketplace registration. Each standard is described below — what it requires, and who asks for it.
certs_heading: No single certification covers everything. Together, these do.
certs_intro: HACCP covers food safety processes. FRESHCARE covers farm-to-packing food safety and sustainability. HARPS covers retailer-specific requirements. SEDEX covers ethical trading. Together they meet the requirements of Australian retailers, humanitarian agencies, government bodies and institutional buyers across every dimension they evaluate.
integrity_heading: Eighteen years of trading, held to the same standards.
integrity_body_1: That isn't a slogan — it's a track record. Bungle was founded in 2008 on a straightforward premise: deliver what you promise, be honest about what you can and can't do, and build relationships that last. We're founder-led and privately owned. No private equity pressure, no offshore parent, no conflicting interests.
integrity_body_2: We mean what we say in a quote — we quote competitively and accurately, not low to win and high to retain. Our unique proprietary software, built specially for Bungle and our customers, makes pricing consistent, documented and auditable: every invoice matches the purchase order, every purchase order matches the quote.
security_heading: When you put us on your supplier list, you're trusting us with more than food.
security_intro: Security is an increasingly explicit requirement from institutional buyers — and food businesses are now among the most-targeted sectors for ransomware, with attacks up 118% in late 2024 on the year before. We take both physical and cyber security seriously, and we have the procedures to prove it.
